About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.
We currently have internship opportunities open for undergraduate students at our Auckland office. 
Responsibilities:
Support senior project managers with everyday tasks on game development projects.
Take part in business related tasks and projects.
Liaise and communicate with internal and external stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.
Plan and execute business development programs.
Work with teams in our global offices.
Use various business and project management tools.
Other project support work as required.

Who We Look For
Highly self-motivated, able to take charge and responsibility for tasks and objectives to carry them through to completion.
Excellent communication skills, both in written and oral form, to work effectively with others.
Ability to think outside the box.
Excellent business tools skills, i.e. MS Office suite of tools and other business tools.
Multilingual, fluent in English and Chinese and able to communicate effectively for business purposes in both oral and written form.
People skills, able to build up working relationships and enjoys working with people of various backgrounds and cultures.
Someone who enjoys computer games or has a good understanding of the gaming industry would be a plus.

Interested candidates please send your CV along with a brief cover letter.
